description: This Java class 'ChatManager' manages socket communication for a Wi-Fi Direct chat application. It handles reading incoming messages on a background thread and sending messages through an output stream, communicating with the UI thread via a Handler.

classes.name: ChatManager
classes.description: A class that manages socket communication for a chat system, handling reading from and writing to a socket, and relaying messages to the UI thread.

methods.name: ChatManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the socket and handler.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main thread for reading messages from the socket input stream and forwarding them to the UI handler.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Method to send a string message over the socket asynchronously.
